react-runtime.js contains only MIT-licensed React 19.2.7, React DOM 19.2.7,
and Scheduler modules, plus a small CommonJS loader exposing React/ReactDOM.
The modules were recovered from an existing installed distribution because
network access was unavailable. No application-specific modules are included.
Upstream: https://github.com/facebook/react . See LICENSE.txt.
This runtime is included so the application works offline without npm.
For upgrades, replace it with a reviewed official react + react-dom/client
bundle and update package.json. Keep this license and verify all workflows.

SHA256 (reviewed local asset): 0058b01e3526a9959611ee942ad4bd01f5e3b76816b718d5832ae954515c2e9b
